name: Trim Interstage (Between Coats)
intent: Inspect the cured first finish coat, sand between coats, patch any defects revealed by the first coat, spot-coat patches, clean dust before the second coat. Trim ALWAYS gets sanded between coats regardless of QT (different from drywall where interstage is QT4+ only) because trim takes a high-gloss finish that magnifies any surface texture.

tasks.name: Inspect Trim First Coat
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 800 LF/hr matching the prep inspect rate; same kind of work.

tasks.name: Sand Trim Between Coats
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 300 LF/hr based on light sand trim prep (200 LF/hr for sand prep) at 1.5x because between-coat sanding is finer grit and lighter pressure.

tasks.name: Patch Trim Defects
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 600 LF/hr; this is spot work on isolated defects, not full surface coverage.

tasks.name: Spot Coat Trim Patches
tasks._doctrine_note: RATE_GAP_FILL: estimated 800 LF/hr for spot brush over patched areas.

doctrine: Trim interstage is mandatory for ALL quality tiers because residential trim takes a satin/semigloss/gloss sheen that reveals every surface defect. This is meaningfully different from drywall where interstage only fires for QT4/QT5 — drywall walls take eggshell/flat which hides surface texture. Most rates here are gap-filled estimates flagged in individual tasks.
